instruction: Align the first paragraph of the document to the center.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the first paragraph alignment from LEFT to CENTER. Verified current document has first paragraph with LEFT alignment (None/default). Custom getter extracts alignment from paragraph 0, metric checks if it equals 1 (CENTER). Alignment values: 0=LEFT, 1=CENTER, 2=RIGHT, 3=JUSTIFY.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts alignment from paragraph 0 (first paragraph), matching the instruction requirement
Metric correctly compares alignment value against expected CENTER alignment (value=1)
Expected value is semantically correct: expected_alignment=1 corresponds to CENTER alignment as required by instruction
Postconfig appropriately saves the document (Ctrl+S) to ensure changes are persisted before verification
Complete coverage: instruction has one requirement (center align first paragraph), evaluator verifies exactly that requirement
Edge cases handled properly: getter handles None alignment (defaults to LEFT), out-of-range paragraph index, and file read errors
Data flow is logically sound: getter extracts state -> metric compares -> returns 1.0 if alignment matches CENTER
